proof_body:
by
  intro Ω ι _ _ P _ X a σ2 hne hL hc hv ha
  classical
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ σ2 := by
    have i := hne.some
    rw [← hv i]; exact ProbabilityTheory.variance_nonneg _ _
  have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have e : ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => ∑ i, a i * X i ω) P = σ2 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_fun_sum' (fun i _ => (hL i).const_mul (a i)), Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.covariance_const_mul_left, ProbabilityTheory.covariance_const_mul_right, ProbabilityTheory.covariance_self (hL i).aemeasurable, hv]
      ring
    · intro j _ hji
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.covariance_const_mul_left, ProbabilityTheory.covariance_const_mul_right, hc i j hji.symm]
      ring
    · simp
  rw [e, div_le_iff₀ hcard]
  have hcs := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := Finset.univ) (f := a)
  rw [ha, Finset.card_univ] at hcs
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (∑ i, a i ^ 2) * Fintype.card ι := by nlinarith
  nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a : ι → ℝ) (σ2 : ℝ), Nonempty ι → (∀ i, MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 P) → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ProbabilityTheory.covariance (X i) (X j) P = 0) → (∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.variance (X i) P = σ2) → ∑ i, a i = 1 → σ2 / (Fintype.card ι) ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => ∑ i, a i * X i ω) P
